feeds.note: Membrane publishes articles at getmembrane.com/articles; no RSS/Atom feed was found on the host.

purge.reason: MISATTRIBUTION. Ten posts filed under this repo were harvested from feed_url https://integrationapp.com/feed, which is INTAPP (intapp.com, legal/accounting software), not Integration.app/Membrane (integration.app -> getmembrane.com). Every removed post linked to intapp.com/news/*. A one-character domain collision (integrationapp.com vs integration.app) put another company's content in this profile. The prior blogs.json compounded it by recording the feed source as https://getmembrane.com/pricing, which is not a feed and no longer resolves.
